question: Who won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in Kuchipudi in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry:-**

 
 
• **Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry is a renowned Kuchipudi dancer, artist, choreographer, and guru. **
 
• He was born in 1958 in Gudivada, Krishna district, Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• He learned Kuchipudi dance from his father, Pasumarthy Ramakrishna Sastry.
 
• He later learned Bharatanatyam from renowned gurus such as Rukmini Devi Arundale and Vempati Chinna Satyam.
 
• **He won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in Kuchipudi in 2018.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Madambi Subramanian Namboodiri:-**

 
 
• **He is a Kathakali musician from Kerala, India. **
 
• He was born on June 15, 1943, in Sreekrishnapuram, Palakkad district.
 
• He received training in Kathakali music from Ramankutty Warrier, K. Madhava Panicker, Kalamandalam Neelakandan Nambeesan, and Kalamandalam Shivaraman Nair.
 
• He has also studied Carnatic music under Kongorppilli Parameswaran Namboodiri.
 
 
 
• **Manjamma Jogathi:-**
 
 
• **She is an Indian actress, singer, and dancer of Jogathi Nritya, a folk dance form from North Karnataka. **
 
• She was born on May 20, 1957, in Kalkamba, Karnataka.
